long_biography.plain_text:
Bringing Miss Universe into Legacy Holding gave Raúl Rocha Cantú's Mexican portfolio a global consumer platform. The investment added international media, live events and brand licensing to businesses previously concentrated in industrial and infrastructure services.

Rocha developed that portfolio from an operating base in hydraulic and pneumatic products. He grouped later ventures across energy infrastructure, private aviation, enterprise technology and real estate, favouring sectors whose capabilities could support one another. At Miss Universe, where he serves as president, his priorities have included regional management, digital products and wider commercial partnerships. The resulting holding structure combines heavy industry with internationally distributed entertainment.

uncertainties.detail: The immutable record and English-language exchange filing use Raul Rocha Cantu without diacritics. His official Spanish company material and established Mexican coverage consistently use Raúl Rocha Cantú. No middle name is evidenced; Rocha and Cantú remain together as his two-surname family name.

The portfolio spans industrial products, energy infrastructure, aviation, technology, property and entertainment. Public evidence does not provide reliable segment values or identify one dominant source of the overall fortune, so Diversified is more defensible than selecting the most visible current business.

Strong sources state that Rocha began in the established family company CYMSA before founding the wider holding structure. They do not establish an inherited controlling stake or quantify family capital, so Self-made — advantaged start records the material platform without converting it into an unsupported inheritance claim.

The exchange filing establishes the investment through Legacy Holding Group USA, and the current official organisation page identifies Rocha as president. The biographies avoid transaction value, changing stake percentages, event results and other transient commercial details.

Monterrey, Nuevo León is consistently reported as his birthplace, but strong public sources do not establish a reliable birth day, month or year. Those fields remain unfilled rather than relying on recently added unsourced dates.

The owner record already contains an X/Twitter URL and it is not duplicated. A previously reported Instagram account is currently unavailable, and no personal LinkedIn or website met the current identity-and-control threshold; only the official Legacy company site is proposed.

Both biographies and the dossier narrative omit vessel facts, politics, allegations, controversies, legal matters, sensitive private information, current net worth, rankings, transaction values and changing ownership percentages.
